title: Nearo Gaze
description: Dark theme with desaturated blue-cyan backgrounds and vivid neon accents: cyan, blue-violet, orange-yellow, reddish magenta and lime.

title: GitBrainsLog
description: Panel de Git Log al estilo de los IDE de JetBrains: ramas, grafo de commits, detalles y menú contextual.

title: MCAP Viewer & ROS Bag Viewer
description: MCAP viewer for VS Code: open .mcap and ROS 1 .bag files to see topics, message types, counts, rates, the time range, schemas and chunk compression, read decoded messages (ROS 1, ROS 2 CDR, JSON, protobuf) and plot a field over time. Offline, no account.

title: PCD Viewer & LAS Point Cloud
description: PCD viewer for VS Code: open .pcd point clouds (ascii, binary, binary_compressed) and uncompressed .las LiDAR files in a 3D view. Color by height, intensity, RGB, label or class with a legend, read the header and field table, pick a point to see its fields. Offline, no account.
